issues.what: The pedestrian bridge's outer face has a saturated blue panel and a magenta panel only in the konbini view. In street, balcony and high, the same face is plain grey-blue or translucent glass panels with no color.
issues.where: konbini.png: bridge fascia, left and center (blue panel about x460-580, magenta panel about x825-1005)
issues.fix: Use one bridge-panel material set everywhere. Either remove the blue and magenta inserts, or add them to the shared bridge asset so they show up in street, balcony and high too.

issues.what: The striped konbini fascia (white, red, green and blue bands with the mart lettering) sits in a different place in each view. Konbini and terrace put it at the foot of the bridge. In high, the store at the bridge foot under the stairs has no fascia at all, and a separate striped storefront appears further down the street past the bridge. That makes two konbini-like shops.
issues.where: high.png: plain shelf-lit store under the stairs (x560-660, y420-520) vs. striped storefront (x780-840, y320-360). konbini.png: right side. terrace.png: center back (x1130-1275, y455-490)
issues.fix: Choose one konbini position (at the bridge foot beside the pillar, as konbini and terrace show it) and put the stripe fascia and mart sign on that store. Remove or reskin the duplicate striped front in high, or give the shelf store its fascia.

issues.what: The staircase that climbs to the bridge changes side and material. Balcony and high show one dark navy steel stair on the konbini side, attached to the left building. Konbini shows a rust-brown stair with wooden landing railings on the side opposite the konbini, rising beside a brown wooden building.
issues.where: konbini.png: left (x0-440, y380-640). balcony.png and high.png: left steel stair
issues.fix: Keep stair geometry and material identical: dark steel, on the same side of the street as the konbini. If a second stair exists on the far side, show it in balcony and high and use the same steel material.

issues.what: A wide, chunky dark stair fills the street view foreground, with a vertical red/green/blue logo plaque at its top. No such broad stair or plaque appears in any other view. Balcony and high show only a narrow steel stair on that side.
issues.where: street.png: left third (x0-440, whole height), plaque at about x20-60, y200-270
issues.fix: Either use the narrow steel stair in the street foreground, or add this broad stair and its logo plaque to the level so balcony and high show it.

issues.what: The izakaya sits in different places relative to the bridge and the crosswalk. Balcony, high and street put it close to the crosswalk on the camera side of the bridge, more or less facing the konbini and stairs. Konbini shows it far down the street on the other side of the bridge, with the crosswalk beyond the bridge too, so the block layout reads mirrored and shifted.
issues.where: konbini.png: izakaya awning about x540-690, y505-640, beyond the bridge. balcony.png: right foreground
issues.fix: Check the konbini camera against the real layout and fix block placement so the izakaya and konbini keep the same street-side and bridge-relative positions in every view.

issues.what: Konbini shows a white-and-blue vending machine and cyan/pink glowing panels just past the izakaya. Street shows a red-canopied food stall with orange signs right beside the izakaya instead, and no second vending machine.
issues.where: konbini.png: about x690-760, y580-640. street.png: right edge, x1510-1672, y500-640
issues.fix: Fill the stretch next to the izakaya the same way in both views: the red stall, or the white vending machine plus neon panels, not one in each.

issues.what: Rain intensity and form don't match. High, terrace and balcony show a heavy downpour of long, dense streaks. Konbini shows sparse short dots, more like light drizzle. Street sits in between, with shorter streaks and sparkle squares.
issues.where: konbini.png: whole frame vs. high.png, terrace.png and balcony.png
issues.fix: Use the same rain particle settings (density, streak length, opacity) for every camera. Make sure density is not tied to distance or the view frustum in a way that thins it at street level.

issues.what: Overall exposure and atmosphere change between views. Konbini is far brighter, with a lavender fog-lit sky, glowing skyscrapers and a heavily blooming storefront. Balcony and high are a dark navy night. In high and terrace the same konbini front is dim and barely emissive.
issues.where: konbini.png: whole frame, mart windows. high.png and terrace.png: the striped storefront
issues.fix: Lock exposure/tonemapping and fog for all captures, and give the konbini signage and windows the same emissive intensity everywhere, so it is a bright beacon in high and terrace too, or less blown out in konbini.

issues.what: The terrace shows red-cushioned bar stools around each café table (four visible). High looks straight down on the same three tables and shows bare table discs with no stools.
issues.where: terrace.png: stools around the tables. high.png: tables at about x1020, x1120 and x1245, y450-515
issues.fix: Make sure the stool meshes exist at all LODs and render from high. Place them around the tables in the shared scene, not in a terrace-only group.

issues.what: Bridge railing scale is inconsistent. In terrace, the parapet is a tall opaque lavender panel that reaches well above table height, about chest to head height. In high and balcony it reads as a low, waist-height grey rail that leaves the tables in plain sight.
issues.where: terrace.png: side panels. high.png: bridge parapet near the tables
issues.fix: Use one parapet height and color, then check that the tables' visibility from high matches what that height allows.

issues.what: From terrace, the far end of the bridge meets a flat facade with nothing there: no stair head, no landing, no connection. High and balcony show the steel stair rising to that end of the bridge.
issues.where: terrace.png: end of the walkway, center (about x770-890, y400-460)
issues.fix: Show the stair head or landing opening at the bridge end in terrace view so it lines up with the stair seen in balcony and high.

issues.what: Crosswalk markings differ. Balcony and high show a normal zebra of evenly spaced, uniform bars. Street shows irregular, scattered white slabs of different lengths over the whole road in front of the izakaya, as if they float on the water.
issues.where: street.png: lower right road (x700-1672, y660-900) vs. balcony.png bottom and high.png lower left
issues.fix: Use one zebra decal or mesh with fixed bar count, length and spacing. Make sure the bars sit on the road and the water/reflection plane doesn't cut through them.

issues.what: Road markings don't match. Balcony shows a white dashed center line and a yellow curb line in front of the izakaya. Street and konbini show neither the dashed center line nor, in street, the yellow line by the izakaya.
issues.where: balcony.png: road center (x830-860) and right curb. street.png and konbini.png: road surface
issues.fix: Use a single road-marking decal set. Check that the reflective wet-road shader doesn't hide the decals at low camera angles.

issues.what: The wet-road reflection looks very different by view. High shows a large rainbow-glitch smear that covers the whole intersection. Konbini and balcony show a mostly black mirror with tidy vertical neon streaks. Street shows a water-like surface with ripples.
issues.fix: Use one SSR/planar reflection setup and clamp the distortion so a top-down angle doesn't turn into a psychedelic smear. Keep puddle coverage the same in every view.

issues.what: The neon and sign set doesn't hold up. Terrace shows '24HR' over an amber storefront and a red-pink lettered sign over a red-lantern shop. Neither sign is visible in high, which covers the same facades, or in konbini, where the brown building carries a different small yellow sign.
issues.where: terrace.png: about x235-290, y450 and x1525-1620, y450. high.png: amber storefront at left, orange store at center
issues.fix: Give each storefront one fixed sign mesh and text, and check from every camera that it renders and isn't culled.

verdict: FAIL. This doesn't read as one place. The konbini view is the main outlier: the bridge gets colored panels no other view has, the stairs move to the opposite side of the street, the izakaya jumps to the far side of the bridge, the rain thins to drizzle and the exposure is much brighter. The konbini storefront and its stripe fascia sit somewhere different in every view, high is missing the stools, and the street foreground has a stair no other view shows. Lock the layout, the materials, the rain and the exposure across all cameras before any polish.
